correctness.rationale: The icosahedral graph and 80 forbidden triples are encoded explicitly; the verifier compares two predicates on all 4096 masks, reconstructs 323 faces, all 120 graph automorphisms from two vertex-fixed generators, 9905 strict flags and exactly 118 quotient cells. The 2-skeleton triangular-relator elimination kills all 55 generators of pi1(K), and Armstrong gives pi1 of the quotient trivial. Exact integer elementary row/column operations reduce cellular boundaries to 9,26,23 unit diagonal entries; chain compositions vanish. Consequently integral quotient homology equals that of S3 with no torsion; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead yield homotopy equivalence S3. All finite checks were executed from the included verify.py, not only from logs.

value.rationale: The canonical icosahedral dissociation complex is already known to have a 20-dimensional 3-homology module with exactly one full-group rational fixed line. The unresolved integral topology of its full geometric quotient is a natural structural gap: rational homology alone does not control torsion or perfect fundamental groups. This exact homotopy classification identifies a three-sphere, using an exceptionally small 118-cell orbit model and two generator fixed-point argument; it is not a change of notation, routine parameter increment, or a recomputation of existing rational character data.
